image_description: A dark-furred wombat is resting in a sheltered area beneath a reddish rock overhang. The animal is positioned on a paved surface with visible grout lines, partially obscured by the rock above. The lighting suggests an outdoor or semi-outdoor enclosure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Facial features are small relative to broad head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is stocky and heavy-set with a substantial, ground-hugging build.
